difficulty_reason: The counted statement shows that the diagonal of a morphism of algebraic stacks is representable by algebraic spaces and locally of finite type (author lemma at source lines 343-356, label lemma-properties-diagonal). The proof (source lines 358-402) unwinds what a test morphism into the square of the stack is, exhibits the pullback of the diagonal as a fibre product of the two isomorphism spaces and concludes representability, then obtains local finite type from the corresponding statement for isomorphism spaces together with base change and composition permanence (proof lines 358-401). The identification of the pullback with the fibre product of the isomorphism spaces is the content. H3.
